top_choice_rationale: P001 rests on one clear idea, trapping neutral atoms at a magic wavelength so that both clock states see the same light shift, which Katori proposed and demonstrated and Ye carried to the 10^-18 level. The result is reproduced and cross-compared by independent laboratories, rests on atomic-structure physics I can judge directly (blackbody and lattice light shifts), and has a clean two-name allocation and citation. P002 is a genuine new class of matter, but its credit chain (Bernevig, Hughes, Zhang, and the 3D work) is contested and its proponent himself says he would move to P001 if the experts cannot defend the trio, so I rank it second, above no award.
recusal_note: Long-time close collaborator of Anne L'Huillier and co-author with Lund and ETH attosecond groups; no direct connection to Katori or Ye apparent from profile, so none apparent beyond field proximity (atomic structure theory underlying clock shifts).
